synthetic_contract_grid.rationale: Fixed ABSOLUTE half-point thresholds, declared here before evaluation. Outcome-independent by construction: no threshold depends on any realised score. Mirrors real Kalshi ladders, which are quoted at absolute round numbers, not model-relative offsets.
synthetic_contract_grid.pricer: projections.distribution normal + 0.5 continuity correction, applied to to_game_distribution() -- the exact deployed Kalshi contract path (confirmed by Week 0 ladder inversion, fit residual 0.000)

clustering_rules.fitting: game-equal weighting: every game contributes total weight 1.0, split evenly across its synthetic contracts, so a game with 22 spread contracts cannot outvote a game with 22 total contracts or dominate the fit.
clustering_rules.evaluation: cluster bootstrap resampling WHOLE GAMES with replacement, 2000 iterations; per-game diagnostics reported; contract-level n and game-level n always reported side by side.

temporal_design.rationale: 2025 has already been inspected by the preseason-prior mission and is NOT a pristine holdout for this mission. Rolling-origin evaluation is used instead, every fold reported separately.

folds.note: no prior calibration history; calibration candidates fall back to identity

temporal_design.week0_2026_role: DEVELOPMENT DIAGNOSTIC ONLY -- never a fitting set, never a fold

candidates.name: talent_margin_prior
candidates.hypothesis: CONTROL under-projects early-season margins because preseason ratings compress team differences. The historically confirmed talent slope repairs the point estimate.
candidates.refit_note: beta is FROZEN from the prior mission (fit on 2021-2023). It is NOT refit here and NOT refit on 2026.
candidates.channel: margin mean only; total mean unchanged (home +delta/2, away -delta/2)

candidates.name: early_season_total_bias_correction
candidates.hypothesis: CONTROL over-projects early-season totals. A simple intercept correction, fit chronologically, repairs the total mean.
candidates.form: total_delta = -bias_hat(week_bucket), applied as home -= d/2, away -= d/2 so margin is unchanged
candidates.fitting: bias_hat = game-equal mean of (projected_total - actual_total) over FIT SEASONS ONLY for that week bucket. Chronological, never fit on the evaluation season. Hard-coding -2.94 is forbidden.
candidates.shrinkage: estimate shrunk toward 0 by n/(n+k) with k=50 games, to avoid overfitting a small early-season bucket

candidates.name: favorite_tail_margin_correction
candidates.hypothesis: After Candidate A, residual favourite-tail bias may remain in early season.
candidates.form: ONE simple linear slope on projected absolute margin, fit on FIT SEASONS ONLY, early-season games only
candidates.gating: ONLY evaluated if residual favourite-tail bias after Candidate A still exceeds 3.0 points in magnitude on the fit seasons. If Candidate A suffices, C is not tested (declared here, not decided after seeing results).

candidates.name: spread_probability_calibration
candidates.hypothesis: Raw spread threshold probabilities are miscalibrated, especially in the tails.
candidates.form: monotonic map on logit(p): calibrated_logit = A*logit(p) + B
candidates.fitting: walk-forward on FIT SEASONS ONLY, game-equal weighted, target = realised synthetic threshold outcome. Market prices are NEVER used.
candidates.isotonic_note: isotonic only if a fold has >=500 games of fit history AND platt is visibly inadequate; declared but not expected

candidates.name: total_probability_calibration
candidates.hypothesis: Total threshold probabilities are miscalibrated and must be treated separately from spread.
candidates.form: same functional form as D, fit SEPARATELY on total contracts only
candidates.fitting: identical discipline to D; no transfer of spread parameters to totals is permitted

candidates.name: distribution_scale_repair
candidates.hypothesis: The deployed predictive sd is mis-scaled relative to realised error, causing tail overconfidence.
candidates.form: single multiplicative factor on margin sd and (separately) total sd
candidates.gating: ONLY tested if the diagnostic shows deployed sigma differs from bias-corrected realised RMSE by more than 8% on the fit seasons. Declared here as a gate, not decided after seeing results.
candidates.fitting: factor = bias_corrected_realised_rmse / mean_deployed_sigma on FIT SEASONS ONLY

acceptance_gates.rule: A candidate is ACCEPTED only if ALL of the following hold. 'Best average metric wins' is explicitly rejected.
gates: G1 REPLICATION: improves its primary metric in at least 3 of the 4 evaluable folds (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025). Winning one fold is a rejection.
G2 DIRECTION: the pooled point estimate improves the primary metric, with a game-clustered 95% interval that does not sit predominantly on the harm side.
G3 NO MATERIAL HARM: no evaluated segment (week_1, weeks_1_3, weeks_4_plus) degrades its primary metric by more than 25% of the magnitude of the improvement claimed elsewhere.
G4 CALIBRATION: for probability candidates, ECE must not worsen, and the extreme bins (0-5%, 95-100%) must not worsen in absolute calibration error.
G5 SIMPLICITY TIE-BREAK: if two candidates are statistically indistinguishable, the one with fewer fitted parameters is chosen. Identity beats a fitted map at a tie.

primary_metrics.probability_candidates: Brier on synthetic contracts (D, E, F), with log loss and ECE as co-equal guards

acceptance_gates.combination_rule: The combined candidate is built ONLY from accepted components, and must itself pass all gates on the full rolling-origin evaluation. Individually-positive components are NOT automatically stacked.

stop_conditions: CONTROL cannot be reproduced (NOT triggered -- reproduction passed)
candidate wins only one historical fold
acceptance criteria would have to change after seeing results

promotion_rule.prospective_boundary: A promoted model may only capture PROSPECTIVELY from its freeze time forward. The scanner must never emit new-version rows for historical or missed checkpoints.
